threads.body: `ColBERTv2` accepts the endpoint port separately from `url` (the new test constructs it that way), but this helper only parses a port embedded in the URL. As a result, direct ColBERT spans omit `server.port` even though the SDK knows it, and malformed endpoint URLs can also raise from telemetry before the retrieval call runs. Read the instance/RM `port` attribute and make URL parsing best-effort so instrumentation cannot change the call's behavior.
